finalists.label: Frontal sinus mucocele
finalists.why: High signal on T2-weighted image and ring enhancement in the right frontal sinus, along with opacification and expansion of the right frontal sinus, strongly support this diagnosis.

finalists.label: Chronic sinusitis
finalists.why: Opacification on right frontal, ethmoid, and maxillary sinuses, along with expansion of the right frontal and ethmoid sinuses, supports chronic sinusitis.

finalists.label: Orbital Abscess
finalists.why: Presence of an immovable scarlike node discharging pus on the right upper eyelid is a strong indicator of an abscess.

frontier_selector.why: The combination of imaging findings, including high signal on T2-weighted image and ring enhancement in the right frontal sinus, along with clinical presentation, most specifically supports the diagnosis of Frontal sinus mucocele over Orbital Abscess.
